cards.text: Jeremiah, a prophet (Jeremiah 1:5), tells us what the LORD said to him: go and stand at the gate of the people in Jerusalem, the gate the kings of Judah go in and out through. No stage. No microphone. Just Jeremiah at the gate, like the guy with the flyers by the mall entrance, hoping SOMEBODY stops.

cards.question: The LORD sends Jeremiah to the gate of the people, where the kings of Judah come and go. Who does the LORD's message there call to listen?

answers.text: The kings and all the people

cards.question: True or false: The LORD tells Jeremiah to stand at the gate of the people and nowhere else.

cards.text: Every gate in Jerusalem, friend. Jeremiah is about to CRUSH his step count. And the warning starts, 'This is what the LORD says: Take heed for yourselves…'

cards.question: The LORD's warning is about the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. What must the people not do there?
True or false: The LORD's Sabbath rule about loads covers people's houses too, not just the city gates.
No loads and no work on the Sabbath. What does the LORD say the people must do with the Sabbath day instead?

cards.text: And this isn't new, friend. The LORD says He gave this same command to their forefathers.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says the people's forefathers listened to His Sabbath command.

cards.text: Those forefathers 'stiffened their necks' and would not receive His discipline. That's the driver whose GPS says 'recalculating' fifteen times in a row, and he just keeps going STRAIGHT.
Now the LORD sets out two ifs. First: 'If, however, you listen carefully to Me…' and bring no load through the gates on the Sabbath, keep it holy and do no work on it.

cards.question: True or false: If the people keep the Sabbath day holy, the LORD says kings and princes will ride through the gates of Jerusalem.

cards.text: Those kings and princes will sit on the throne of David, Israel's king, riding in chariots and on horses with their officials, along with the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem. That's one traffic jam at the gate I'd be HAPPY to sit in.

cards.question: If the people listen, the LORD says Jerusalem will be inhabited ___.

cards.text: People will come from the cities of Judah, the places around Jerusalem, the land of Benjamin, the foothills, the hill country and the Negev, all headed to the house of the LORD. That's the group chat plan where EVERYBODY actually shows up.

cards.question: If the people listen, others will come from all over to the house of the LORD, bringing ___.

cards.text: Then the second if. If they won't listen to Him and keep the Sabbath day holy by bringing no loads through Jerusalem's gates, the LORD says He will kindle an unquenchable fire in its gates.

cards.question: The LORD warns that the fire in the city's gates will consume something. What does He name?
